svg.desc: \begin{aligned} & A = A^H,\quad Ax = \lambda x \quad \left(x = [x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_{n-1}, x_n]^T,\; x \neq \vec{0}\right) \\ & (Ax)^H = (\lambda x)^H,\quad x^H A^H = \lambda^* x^H \\ & x^H A = \lambda^* x^H \\ & x^H A x = \lambda x^H x,\quad \lambda x^H x = \lambda^* x^H x \\ & x^H x = \langle x_1^*, x_2^*, \ldots, x_{n-1}^*, x_n^* \rangle \cdot \langle x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_{n-1}, x_n \rangle = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^* \cdot x_i = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \lVert x_i \rVert^2 \\ & \lambda \sum_{i=1}^{n} \lVert x_i \rVert^2 = \lambda^* \sum_{i=1}^{n} \lVert x_i \rVert^2 \quad \left(\lVert x \rVert^2 > 0\right) \\ & \lambda = \lambda^* \\ & \text{let } \lambda = a + bi \;\; (a, b \in \mathbb{R}) \\ & \lambda = a + bi = \lambda^* = a - bi \\ & b = 0,\quad \lambda \in \mathbb{R} \end{aligned}
